'''Geor Vers''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sarek]] welcomed an Imperial-aligned individual to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] between [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and [[House of Thul|House Thul]].
